evidence.title: GitHub - ChrisAbdo/MotionVariants: A collection of handmade Framer Motion variants made for your next project.

name: MotionVariants
summary: Collection of handmade Framer Motion animation variants for React and Next.js projects.
description: A collection of handmade Framer Motion variants you can copy into your own project, kept in a Next.js app that demos each animation (create-next-app, Tailwind CSS, framer-motion). The demo site listed on the repo, variantvault.vercel.app, currently returns 404.
contains: handmade Framer Motion variants for React projects
Next.js demo app in the repo (create-next-app, Tailwind CSS)
